verify-email.subject: Confirm your email address
verify-email.heading: Welcome to NexDesk, {name}
verify-email.body: Confirm your email address to finish setting up your workspace.
verify-email.footer: This link expires in {hours} hours. If you did not create a NexDesk workspace, you can ignore this email.

reset-password.subject: Reset your NexDesk password
reset-password.heading: Reset your password
reset-password.body: Hi {name}, we received a request to reset your password. Choose a new one with the button below.
reset-password.footer: This link expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for a reset, your password stays unchanged.

invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {workspace} on NexDesk
invitation.heading: Join {workspace} on NexDesk
invitation.body: {inviter} invited you to work on customer requests with the {workspace} team. Accept the invitation to choose your password and get started.
invitation.footer: This invitation expires in {days} days. If you were not expecting it, you can ignore this email.

notify-assigned.subject: Ticket #{number} was assigned to you
notify-assigned.heading: A ticket was assigned to you
notify-assigned.footer: You can turn these emails off in your NexDesk profile.

notify-reply.subject: New reply on ticket #{number}: {subject}
notify-reply.heading: New reply on ticket #{number}
notify-reply.footer: You get this email because you are assigned to or watching this ticket.

notify-note.subject: New internal note on ticket #{number}: {subject}
notify-note.heading: New internal note on ticket #{number}
notify-note.footer: You get this email because you are assigned to or watching this ticket.

notify-sla-warning.subject: Ticket #{number} is close to its deadline
notify-sla-warning.heading: A deadline is close
notify-sla-warning.body: Ticket #{number} “{subject}” will soon miss its SLA target.
notify-sla-warning.footer: You can turn these emails off in your NexDesk profile.

notify-sla-breach.subject: Ticket #{number} missed its deadline
notify-sla-breach.heading: A deadline was missed
notify-sla-breach.body: Ticket #{number} “{subject}” missed its SLA target and was escalated.
notify-sla-breach.footer: You can turn these emails off in your NexDesk profile.

customer-reply.subject: Re: {subject} [#{number}]
customer-reply.heading: {agent} replied to your request
customer-reply.body: Hi {name}, there is a new reply on your request “{subject}”:
customer-reply.footer: You can reply to this email or use the button above to answer in the {workspace} help centre.

portal-reset-password.subject: Choose a password for {workspace} support
portal-reset-password.heading: Choose your password
portal-reset-password.body: Hi {name}, use the button below to choose a password for the {workspace} help centre.
portal-reset-password.footer: This link expires in {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email.

ticket-received.subject: We received your request: {subject} [#{number}]
ticket-received.heading: We received your request
ticket-received.body: Hi {name}, thanks for contacting {workspace}. Your request “{subject}” was registered as #{number} and our team will get back to you.
ticket-received.footer: Reply to this email to add more information to your request.

ticket-solved.subject: Your request was solved: {subject} [#{number}]
ticket-solved.heading: How did we do?
ticket-solved.body: Hi {name}, your request “{subject}” was marked as solved. It takes ten seconds to tell us how it went.
ticket-solved.footer: Still need help? Reply to this email and your request is reopened.

portal-welcome.subject: Finish setting up your {workspace} support account
portal-welcome.heading: Welcome, {name}
portal-welcome.body: Choose a password to follow your requests at {workspace} online.
portal-welcome.footer: This link expires in {hours} hours. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email.

notify-automation.subject: {actor}: ticket #{number}
notify-automation.heading: {actor}
notify-automation.footer: You can turn these emails off in your NexDesk profile.

automation-message.subject: {title} [#{number}]
automation-message.heading: {title}
automation-message.body: Hi {name}, a message from {workspace} about your request “{subject}”:
automation-message.footer: You can reply to this email or use the button above to answer in the {workspace} help centre.
